title: Mixture-of-Depths with Mirror compute/function routing
hypothesis: At identical token routing and compute budget, a small role-conditioned Mirror view improves function quality over vanilla MoD while using fewer bytes than independent role blocks.
logical_multiplicity: two routed token roles plus residual bypass

development.selection_metric: routed output nMSE, bytes, router and active block MACs

fresh.reason: Direct coefficient view is exact specificity control.

success_gate: Routed-token nMSE <=1e-4; >=20% fewer bytes than independent role blocks; >=10% fewer bytes than direct coefficient control.
failure_gate: Direct coefficients match Mirror or routed quality gate fails.
boundaries: no learned routing or Transformer claim
